sn32.53:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.53:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā sītaṃ hotīti.
sn32.53:1.6: ‘yannūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti’. tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya sītaṃ hoti.
sn32.53:1.7: ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā sītaṃ hotīti.
